name: Castle great hall
desc: the feasting and audience hall where a court gathers and a throne or high table sits
tags: castle great hall, long timber banquet table, wooden benches, wide stone fireplace, iron chandelier with candles, tapestries on stone walls, vaulted timber roof beams, rushes on the floor, tall arched windows
prose: a castle great hall with a long timber banquet table and benches down the centre, a wide stone fireplace at one end, an iron candle chandelier hanging overhead, tapestries on the stone walls and a vaulted timber roof above
note: Without the furniture this renders as a church nave - the long table and benches are the whole difference. The fireplace and the candle chandelier also motivate the light; drop them and you get a flat, evenly lit interior that the firelight and golden grades then have nothing to bite on.
